profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at OurFamilyWizard
profile.summary: Highly passionate, critical thinking, charismatic person that desires to always improve and learn new skills in order to help others achieve their goals. With a strong grasp on relationship building, there is always a way to achieve efficiencies through collaboration.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Optum
positions.description: Developing web services for Optum's Digital Heath Network

positions.title: Student
positions.description: Learning to become proficient software engineers utilizing the full MEAN stack, while also becoming excellent customer service professionals.

positions.title: Business Analyst, Order Management
positions.description:
-Act as the conduit between the business team and the stakeholders to keep projects on track for completion.
-Operationally managed the flow of customer orders working with both IT support and business partners to create a better customer experience.
-Respond quickly to escalations from business partners around possible compromises to maintain the integrity of the project as a whole.
-Develop reporting to fulfill needs of the fulfillment type and business partners to solve any outstanding issues within a project.

positions.title: Sr. Analyst, Quality Operations, Enterprise Customer Care
positions.description:
-Managed day-to-day operations with third-party vendors within a specified call type, handling 10-15k calls per day.
-Ensured Key Performance Indicators were in line of sight at all times through conference calls, call monitoring, and onsite visits.
-Provided coaching and feedback to site leadership to help increase net promoter score and issue resolution.
-Reduced costs of nearly $1.1M by implementing new call flows and program redesign to decrease average call handle time and number of contacts at support centers.

volunteerExperiences.description: Frequent the local Feed My Starving Children locations to pack food to be sent out to third world countries for assistance.
